NoveltyStatement: An integrated workflow connects SPICE-based circuit generation, surrogate modeling, XAI, constrained optimization, SPICE verification and robustness analysis in a single pipeline.
The approach explicitly retains SPICE as physical ground truth rather than treating the learned model as a replacement for circuit simulation.
The framework links global SHAP explanations and parameter interaction analysis with direct SPICE validation.
Optimization is constrained using circuit operating-point criteria derived from actual SPICE operating-point data.
Every final optimization candidate is checked against the physical circuit simulator before being treated as a valid design result.
The workflow evaluates not only nominal optimization results but also tolerance-perturbed physical validity.
